Use the following context to answer the question.

Context:
[Leave Types > GitLab Parental Leave > Eligibility, Entitlement and Planning Your Leave > Returning to Work]
It’s important to acknowledge that returning to work after Parental Leave can be difficult. Even with smooth reentries, life and work interplay differently when one adds another member to their family. Everyone transitions differently, and the impact on an individual varies depending on role, as well as a litany of personal factors.

About a week before your expected return, the Absence Management team will send you a welcome back email which will share resources and ask you to confirm your return to work date. **Please respond by confirming the date you will return.**

More Return-to-work Resources shared [here](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave).

[Leave of Absence Toolkit for Team Members and Managers > Team Member Toolkit > Pre-Leave > Returning from Leave]
Here's what to expect in your first few weeks back from leave: 

[Time Away Philosophy > GitLab's Philosophy to Time Away from Work > Communicating Unplanned Time Away > Manager Responsibilities]
If a team member has contacted you with an unexpected or emergency situation, you should:

1. Confirm their safety and offer support
1. Develop communication strategy with the team member
1. Reassign or develop a coverage plan for the team member’s work as appropriate

For more information about manager’s responsibilities related to absence management, please visit the [Manager Toolkit for Absence](https://theloop.gitlab.com/site/5ea8f77b-a0c3-4983-ba40-1463a96d8e21/page/772afb15-974d-4798-a383-fd7b49ca724d)!
